current.text: Castro is a rookie from the 2026 draft class. He went undrafted.
Houston's projected starters are VanVleet, Thompson, Durant, Smith and Sengun. Steven Adams is back and sits in a crowded bench group.
Coach Ime Udoka plays his starters very heavy minutes. The roster is thin after the top 10 or 11 players.
Experts treat him as a late dynasty rookie flier: Tier 9 in one ranking, around pick 50 in another. Neither ranking is a redraft call.

durable.text: He is a 6'11 big man, 23 years old at the 2026 draft.
Before the NBA he had a very high block rate, a very high steal rate and a high free throw rate. He did not take threes.
His steal numbers are expected to translate well to the NBA. One expert compares him to Paul Reed.

note: Castro is not a draft target for us. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 658th, ESPN has no price, and no site has a projection, so he will not be among the 144 players drafted. His steal and block rates are why he is interesting, but he is behind Sengun, Smith and Adams on a crowded Houston depth chart. Watch only whether he gets real NBA minutes early in the season. Leave him alone otherwise.
